content.text: **Summary:** I resolved ticket T-3006 by identifying that the PVC `data-ledger-db-0` is stuck in Terminating status because the pod `ledger-db-0` is still actively using it. Kubernetes's Storage Object in Use Protection feature is intentionally preventing deletion to avoid data loss. The fix is to delete the `ledger-db-0` pod, after which Kubernetes will automatically remove the finalizer and complete the PVC deletion, allowing the cleanup job to finish before tonight's node patching.
